verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator driven through drivers and the CUDA toolkit. Operating it with natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only that it runs LLM workloads (e.g. NIM microservices for deploying generative AI), not that the GPU itself can be operated through natural-language commands, so the axis does not apply.
